newsitem.title: USA: National Semi to acquire Mediamatics.
newsitem.headline: National Semi to acquire Mediamatics.

text.p: National Semiconductor Corp Monday said it will acquire Mediamatics Inc, a supplier of audio/video decoders to the personal computer market, in exchange for a stock.
National Semiconductor will acquire 100 percent of a Fremont, California-based Mediamatics' stock in exchange for approximately 3.4 million shares of National Semiconductor common stock.
Mediamatics will retain its name and will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary of National Semiconductor.
Prem Nath, Mediamatics' president and chief executive, will serve as president of the new subsidiary and as a National vice president.
The acquisition has been approved by National's board and is expected to close before the end of March 1997.
Mediamatics provides software and semiconductor products enabling full-motion video and CD quality audio using industry standards defined by the Moving Pictures Expert's Group, or MPEG.
National has made aggressive strides to compete with France's SGS-Thomson Microelectronics NV, which is considered the market leader in MPEG Technology.
